title: Figma differences
description: Where a library component and its Figma component differ on purpose, and why, by component; a component that matches its Figma component isn't listed. Edited by hand (the write-figma-differences skill). pnpm figma:export reads its Figma names, and pnpm gen fails on a difference not written here, or one written here that's gone.

components.description: Library components by their export name.

noFigmaComponent.description: A component with no Figma counterpart, and why.

whyNoFigmaComponent.description: Why Figma has none: it draws nothing of its own, or only arranges components that are in Figma.

figmaVariantPropertyNotInCode.description: How code chooses a Figma variant property it has no prop for.

fromProps.description: This component's props that decide it, checked against the code; empty when no prop does (CSS, or another component's prop).

note.description: How those props choose each value, in plain words with code in backticks; or, with no props, what does.

differences.description: How a component differs from its Figma component on purpose.

figmaName.description: Its Figma component's name when that isn't its code name in sentence case: a part drawn inside its family's component (CardBody is drawn in Card).

propsNotInFigma.description: Code props Figma has no variant property for, each with why Figma doesn't need one.

figmaVariantPropertiesNotInCode.description: Figma variant properties code has no prop for, by their name in Figma, each with how code chooses it.

propsWithDifferentValuesInFigma.description: Code props whose values differ from their Figma variant property's on purpose, each with why.

figmaComponent.description: A library component's Figma component, and its differences from it on purpose: the export's entry without its variants, with its figma-differences.json entry.

figmaName.description: The component's (or component set's) name in Figma, exactly.

figmaNodeId.description: The node id of the component or component set: its link's node-id, with - as :.

propsNotInFigma.description: Code props Figma has no variant property for, each with why Figma doesn't need one.

figmaVariantPropertiesNotInCode.description: Figma variant properties code has no prop for, by their name in Figma, each with how code chooses it.

propsWithDifferentValuesInFigma.description: Code props whose values differ from their Figma variant property's on purpose, each with why.
